shots.scene: Low-angle medium shot in a dark signal lab: a small rounded ivory robot boots up on a circular plinth, its cyan visor ignites as a thin line and opens into a soft eye; warm amber key light from camera-left, cool cyan rim, layered translucent panels and drifting dust behind; slow push-in with a foreground glass ring softly out of focus.
shots.notes: Shorts-lite beat 1/3 — introduction. One continuous visual idea: the same small 2.5D robot demonstrates speech recognition in the same signal_lab across all shots. Stylized volumetric forms with bevels, gradients and rim light; not paper cutout and not a black stick figure. Camera x [18,0] y [8,0] z 1.00→1.08, ease inOut. First-shot in is ignored by the player; config fadeIn covers the opening.

shots.line: This is a short English test.
shots.scene: Medium shot of the same robot speaking: concentric cyan sound rings pulse from its chest as glowing word-glyphs — This, is, a, short, English, test. — pop into the air in sync with the voice; the camera arcs right with a slight roll while the lab panels parallax behind.
shots.notes: Shorts-lite beat 2/3 — speech. The chest emitter drives expanding rings; glyphs use the actual word timings from words.json. Camera x [-24,18] y [0,-4] z 1.08→1.12 r 0→0.01, ease inOut. Hard cut on the phrase boundary; keep the robot facing camera-right and its plinth contact shadow. No narrator lip-sync; visor pulses with talkAmount.

shots.line: Whisper should transcribe these words accurately.
shots.scene: Macro-to-wide reveal: the floating word-glyphs snap into six compact cream timecode cards in a 3×2 grid, each stamped with its Whisper start time; the robot gestures to the finished transcript as the camera pulls back, revealing the full signal lab and settling on a clean final composition.
shots.notes: Shorts-lite beat 3/3 — result. Cards carry real word start times: Whisper 5.93, should 6.19, transcribe 6.43, these 7.11, words 7.33, accurately. 7.59. 16:9 layout 3×2; 9:16 layout 1×6 vertical rail. Camera x [12,0] y [-4,0] z 1.18→1.00 r 0.01→0, ease inOut; pull back after the last word. End on a clean hold for ~1.5 s. Hard cut in; no new set. This is the single chosen treatment, not a variant set.
